title: syswonder/robonix
abstract:
Embodied AI Operating System (EAIOS)

Robonix — The Embodied AI Operating System A system substrate for building embodied intelligence across heterogeneous robots. robonix.ai  ·  Documentation  ·  Package catalog  ·  Quick start ## Robonix Robonix is an operating system for embodied intelligence. Embodied cognition holds that intelligence does not come from representation alone. It emerges from a body interacting with an environment: brain and body act together, and general capability is learned through a closed perceive–plan–act loop with the world. That leaves a question of system design rather than of learning — **how should an embodied "brain" be built and run** so a machine can work this way at all? Recent answers come almost entirely from the model side: vision-language-action models, world models that aim to understand and predict an environment, and proposed architectures for an embodied brain. They ask what to learn and how to learn it. We think the brain also has to be *supported* — developed, deployed, executed, and managed on real hardware — and that this is what an operating system is for. Robonix is our attempt to build one. The approach is to decouple models from bodies. Robonix treats AI models and skills as programs and exposes robot hardware as discoverable capabilities, so a body is integrated once while models and skills are written against shared interfaces for cameras, lidar, chassis, arms, mapping, navigation, speech, and more. The goal is simple to state: **train once, deploy on any robot**. Around that, the concerns common to every perceive–understand–plan–act loop are factored into system services spanning perception, interconnection, cognition, and control, so that each robot does not re-implement them. What we want from this is an ecosystem in which embodied software and hardware can advance independently of one another. ## Supported Robots [ ](https://packages.robonix.ai/robots/) Robot bodies published to the catalog, with more on the way: wheel
abstract_zh: 具身智能操作系统（EAIOS）Robonix——一个用于在异构机器人上构建具身智能的系统基座。Robonix 是一个面向具身智能的操作系统，它探索如何在系统层面构建机器人的“大脑”：一个通用基座，使模型能够通过异构机器人本体进行感知、理解、规划和行动，而无需针对每个厂商的 SDK 重写。Robonix 将 AI 模型和技能视为程序，并将机器人硬件暴露为可发现的能力。这种分离使得机器人开发者只需集成一次本体，而模型和技能开发者则可以针对相机、激光雷达、底盘、机械臂、建图、导航、语音等能力的共享接口进行开发。长期目标很简单：一次训练，任意机器人部署。警告：Robonix 处于早期开发阶段，API 和内部设计在版本发布前可能发生变化。支持的机器人包括 AgileX Ranger Mini v3、DEEP Robotics Lite3、WHEELTEC R550 mini_tank 和 Unitree Go2 等。
tldr_zh: Robonix 是一个具身智能操作系统，旨在实现一次训练、任意机器人部署。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：Robonix 提出解耦模型与身体的操作系统设计：将 AI 模型和技能视为程序，把机器人硬件抽象为可发现的能力，通过共享接口（相机、激光雷达、底盘、机械臂、建图、导航、语音等）集成身体，实现“一次训练，任意机器人部署”，并将感知-理解-规划-行动循环共性问题分解为系统级服务。


# 一、动机

> 现有具身智能研究几乎全部集中在模型侧（VLA、世界模型等），缺少对大脑在真实硬件上进行开发、部署、执行和管理的系统支撑。Robonix 认为大脑也需要操作系统，以解决异构机器人上智能体重复实现且难以复用的问题。


# 二、方法

> Robonix 提出解耦模型与身体的操作系统设计：将 AI 模型和技能视为程序，把机器人硬件抽象为可发现的能力，通过共享接口（相机、激光雷达、底盘、机械臂、建图、导航、语音等）集成身体，实现“一次训练，任意机器人部署”，并将感知-理解-规划-行动循环共性问题分解为系统级服务。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 暂无公开的定量实验结果；项目处于早期生态建设阶段，已发布轮式等机器人本体目录，目标是通过系统服务避免每个机器人都重复实现感知、互联、认知和控制底层逻辑。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题直接相关，提供了具身智能系统级的设计视角：操作系统层面的抽象有助于跨本体迁移和软硬件独立演进，但目前缺少实验验证和性能数据，后续可关注其接口设计与实际部署效果。
